token_matching.rule: A token matches only when the characters immediately before and after the candidate are not ASCII token characters.
applies_to: canonical/aliases of tags whose match_policy is token_exact
ASCII aliases of length 3 or less, including PT, OT and ST

allowance_suffix_variants.scope: Insert the optional particle immediately before the terminal allowance suffix of canonical, strict aliases, and loose aliases. The generated variant keeps the original confidence level.
